answer: Every agent binds a non-exportable hardware key to one grid-tied meter and locks a refundable bond as its identity anchor. The scarce resource is the meter point: a utility issues only one signed binding per service address. Neighbors form a trellis of checks, each sending a fresh nonce and verifying the meter certificate plus a live challenge-response. A roaming raven inspector may arrive unannounced and demand an LED blink timed to a new nonce. A failed quote or reused meter burns the bond. Each fake ID costs another exclusive meter, module, stake, and on-site inspection, linear in n.
